releases.body:
Initial Doubao CLI provider for Magpie and OpenCode 2 on Linux.

```sh
git clone https://github.com/stormluke/opencode-doubao.git
bash opencode-doubao/install.sh magpie  # or opencode
```

15 package tests pass. Magpie API round trips and OpenCode 2.0.11 text/read/write in a reduced configuration were verified. Tool calls are experimental; full OpenCode configuration exceeded the test timeout. See [limits and validation](https://github.com/stormluke/opencode-doubao/blob/v0.1.0/docs/limits.md).
